title: Eligibility
text: Synthetic sample plan covers accidental device damage within 365 days of purchase, subject to active coverage and a maximum covered amount of 50000 INR. This is not an actual insurance policy.

title: Exclusions
text: Intentional damage, cosmetic-only scratches and incidents occurring before coverage starts are excluded. Missing documentation requires human review, not automatic denial.

title: Evidence
text: A claim needs proof of purchase, incident description and dated evidence. Unclear or contradictory evidence must be referred to a human reviewer.

title: Resolution
text: Automated checks are advisory only. A human reviewer makes final decisions. The assistant must cite supporting policy IDs and must abstain when the evidence is insufficient.
